About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Initial conversation: a chat with someone from our Talent team about your experience, what you’re looking for and the role

  • System design interview: a 60-minute technical conversation exploring how you approach architecture, trade-offs and complex engineering decisions

  • Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation focused on people leadership, delivery and cross-functional collaboration

  • Bar raiser: a 45-minute conversation with colleagues from outside the immediate team, focused on our operating principles and how you approach your work

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

Seccl is entering a pivotal stage of growth. Almost one million investors rely on our technology, we power investment propositions for brands including Monzo, Tide and MoneySuperMarket, and our expansion into Europe is underway.

We’ve proved our model can scale. Now we want to accelerate, winning bigger customers, deepening our existing partnerships and opening up new markets. We believe Seccl can become the defining investment infrastructure business of its generation, and our chief commercial officer will play a central role in getting us there.

You’ll join our executive leadership team and lead sales, account management, customer success and marketing. You’ll set our commercial strategy, build the organisation for our next stage of growth and stay close to the customers, opportunities and partnerships that matter most.

You’ll also help shape Seccl’s wider direction, working closely with product, engineering, finance, operations, risk and compliance to make sure customer insight and commercial opportunity influence where we invest and what we build.

What you’ll own

  • Setting and delivering Seccl’s commercial strategy and growth plans

  • Building and leading a high-performing commercial organisation across sales, account management, customer success and marketing

  • Winning significant new customer firms and strategic partnerships

  • Growing our existing customer relationships and creating greater long-term value for Seccl and our customers

  • Leading our most important enterprise opportunities, negotiations and executive-level relationships

  • Shaping our expansion into Europe, new markets and new customer segments

  • Bringing strong customer and market insight into Seccl’s product and company strategy

  • Owning commercial planning, forecasting, retention and expansion

  • Building Seccl’s reputation and influence across the wealth and investment industry

This role’s for you if...

You’re a commercial leader who has helped a financial services business through significant growth. You can think several years ahead while still getting personally involved in the pitch, negotiation or customer conversation that matters today.

  • You have significant senior commercial leadership experience in financial services, ideally across investment platforms, wealth management, financial advice or banking

  • You’ve built and delivered commercial strategies that have generated significant, sustainable growth

  • You know how to win major new customers and grow strategic relationships over the long term

  • You’re comfortable personally leading complex enterprise opportunities, negotiations and senior customer relationships

  • You understand how to commercialise technology-led products and can turn complex capability into clear customer value

  • You’re an experienced people leader who can build strong teams, develop future leaders and create a high-performing culture

  • You have strong commercial and financial judgement and are comfortable operating in a regulated environment

  • You’re curious about how new technology, including AI, can create better propositions and new commercial opportunities

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You want to operate purely at a strategic level. Our leaders stay close to the work and get involved when it matters

  • You see commercial as a standalone function. You’ll need to work closely across the business to make Seccl more successful

  • You’re mainly motivated by winning new logos. Growing and deepening our existing customer relationships matters just as much

  • You need everything fully defined before you act. You’ll need to make good decisions with imperfect information and adapt quickly

  • You’re comfortable maintaining the status quo. We’re looking for someone who wants to raise the bar and help Seccl become significantly bigger and better

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 Competitive salary and bonus, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing. We want you to have plenty of opportunity to get to know Seccl, the role and the people you’d be working with, just as we want to get to know you.

Following an initial conversation with our Talent team, we expect the process to include:

  • First stage: 45-minute interview with our CEO

  • Second stage: 45-minute interview with our executive chair and chief product officer

  • Third stage: 45-minute interview with our commercial director, followed by 45 minutes with our people partnering and development lead, focused on your leadership approach and experience

  • Final stage: a live business case with members of our executive team, focused on strategic thinking, commercial judgement and problem-solving

We’ll only close the role once we have enough applications progressing to the next stage, so we’d encourage you to apply when you’re ready.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Hybrid with travel to Bath, London and Edinburgh a couple times a month

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We're looking for a Platform engineer to shape and evolve the platform that underpins our investment products. You’ll be someone who loves understanding engineering problems and enabling teams to self-serve their needs. You view the cloud platform as a product, and engineering as your customer.

The role is within our Cloud Resilience team - a critical squad within our engineering organisation responsible for empowering squads to build and run their own services.

We’re primarily in AWS, utilising Lambda, ECS, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Aurora, Redshift among others. Our main data store is MongoDB Atlas and our observability platform is Datadog. Our application is written in Typescript/NodeJS and our infrastructure is defined in Terraform.

On a typical day you will be…

  • Architecting, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure infrastructure in AWS using Terraform.

  • Designing cloud-native solutions using MongoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, and other AWS services with a strong focus on serverless.

  • Contributing to incident response efforts, production readiness, and reliability initiatives across engineering squads.

  • Enhancing observability and platform insight through actionable alerting and data visibility using Datadog.

  • Continuously improving CI/CD processes with GitHub Actions, reducing friction in delivery pipelines.

  • Collaborating with software engineers (working in Node.js/TypeScript) to ensure secure, performant, and resilient applications.

  • Mentoring engineers and champion DevOps culture and best practices across teams.

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re a pragmatic platform engineer with experience in regulated environments, balancing delivery with compliance and operational excellence.

  • You’re confident working with JavaScript/TypeScript-based applications and collaborating closely with development teams.

  • You know what “good” looks like for databases like MongoDB and Postgres and can diagnose, design, and optimise for scale and resilience.

  • You care deeply about observability - you don’t just monitor systems, you build alerts that engineers can act on.

  • You’re fluent in AWS best practices, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD tooling like GitHub Actions.

  • You’ve had exposure to architectural decisions and willingness to own of platform-level outcomes.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):

  • First stage – 60 mins Cloud System Design interview

  • Second stage – 60 mins Terraform Code Review Interview

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Talent partner

Hybrid role to be based in our Holborn, London or George Street, Edinburgh office.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a talent partner to join our People team, reporting to our talent lead. We have an ambitious hiring plan and need an experienced recruiter who can help us bring great people into Seccl at pace.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You’ll primarily support our Product and Engineering teams, owning roles from intake and sourcing through to interview, offer and close. Product and Engineering will be your core focus, but you’ll also pick up hiring across other teams as our priorities change.

You’ll build trusted relationships with hiring managers and bring clear advice, market insight and constructive challenge. You’ll help teams make strong decisions and keep hiring moving, while recognising that hiring managers remain accountable for the final call.

Things move quickly here and plans change. You’ll need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, adapting your approach and switching focus without losing momentum. You’ll care about a high hiring bar and a brilliant candidate experience, while staying pragmatic about how we get there.

What you’ll own

  • Delivering end-to-end hiring across a portfolio of roles, primarily within Product and Engineering, while flexing across Seccl when priorities change to support with non-Technical roles

  • Building strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, agency management, creative search approaches and thoughtful engagement

  • Creating pace across every hiring process, spotting blockers early and keeping candidates and hiring teams moving

  • Partnering with hiring managers and leaders to clarify what they need, share market insight and support strong, evidence-based decisions

  • Maintaining a high hiring bar and an inclusive, engaging experience without adding unnecessary process or complexity

  • Using hiring data and day-to-day insight to improve delivery, sharing practical ideas with the talent lead and wider People team

This role’s for you if...

  • You have strong experience owning and delivering end-to-end recruitment across multiple live roles in a fast moving, scaling business

  • You bring genuine expertise in Product and Engineering hiring, with the technical understanding and market knowledge to work credibly with hiring teams

  • You’re a confident direct sourcer who knows how to find, engage and build relationships with strong candidates

  • You’re highly delivery-focused, organised and proactive, and you naturally create momentum without needing lots of direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can change direction quickly when business priorities shift

  • You can challenge constructively, stay pragmatic and judge when to advise, when to push and when to help a hiring manager move forward

  • You’re happy to recruit outside your core specialism when needed. Experience in a fast-paced or scale-up environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a mainly strategic or project-based role. Most of your time will be spent actively delivering hiring and owning live roles

  • You need priorities and processes to stay fixed. Our needs can change quickly, so you’ll need to adapt and make sensible calls without perfect information

  • You prefer to stay within one recruitment specialism. Product and Engineering will be your focus, but you’ll pick up roles across Seccl when needed

  • You see partnership as owning the final hiring decision. We want you to bring expertise and challenge, while enabling hiring managers to make the call and keep things moving

  • You rely mainly on inbound applications or agencies. Direct sourcing and proactive pipeline building are important parts of this role

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £65,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days each year

🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

📖 £750 annual learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

First stage - competencies based interview with the talent lead

Second stage - interview with the head of people and talent lead to delve into your technical skills (this may include a case study or live interview task)

Final stage - 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview with two key stakeholders for this role

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

 

Compensation: £55K – £65K

title: Senior Manager, AI Architect
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

 

Our Solutions & AI Lab (SAIL) practice are looking for an experienced AI Architect to join the team. 

Our Solutions & AI Labs practice helps clients control their data, turn it into actionable insight, and better leverage it through AI and Machine Learning solutions embedded directly into business processes. We support clients across a range of industries and offer deep expertise in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering and Managed Solutions. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to serve as an AI Architect — someone who can design the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI platforms, lead consultancy engagements, and grow our AI & Solutions Engineering capability. 

The AI Architect role owns the technical blueprint for AI-enabled solutions delivered in and around our clients’ environments, combining deep architectural specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to shape and grow our practice. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, AI platform architecture and hands-on delivery leadership — and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI systems to production at scale. 

What you will be doing

As a Senior Manager and AI Architect, you will own and lead the architecture of complex AI programmes end-to-end — from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through solution design, delivery governance and team leadership. You will bring SME-level depth in enterprise AI architecture and apply it to create real, lasting value for our clients. 

Although we do not expect you to be an expert in every technology listed below simultaneously, our team consists of people who can advise clients as well as bring deep technical knowledge when needed. Key responsibilities span the following areas. 

Engagement & delivery leadership 

  • Own and lead the architecture of complex AI and data transformation engagements, taking accountability for solution design, quality, technical risk and client outcomes. 
  • Lead and resource multi-disciplinary delivery teams — architects, engineers, data scientists and consultants — providing clear direction, technical oversight and people development. 
  • Manage engagement resourcing: forecast team requirements, work with practice leadership to staff engagements, and develop the talent pipeline through mentoring of junior practitioners. 
  • Proactively identify and manage delivery and architectural risks in complex stakeholder environments, escalating appropriately and maintaining client confidence throughout. 
  • Communicate clearly to both technical teams and senior client stakeholders, translating architectural complexity into actionable insight and decisive recommendation. 
  • Conduct rigorous architecture and design reviews and uphold engineering standards across every engagement you lead. 

Stakeholder management & advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to client architects, CTOs, CDAOs and engineering leads, earning trust through depth of knowledge and a demonstrable delivery track record. 
  • Build and maintain strong, senior client relationships, navigating competing priorities across business, technology and risk functions. 
  • Facilitate architecture workshops and decision forums, driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and securing buy-in for target-state designs. 
  • Translate business strategy into architectural roadmaps, sequencing investment and change in a way that balances ambition with deliverability. 

Business development & bid support 

  • Play a leading role in business development: identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions, and supporting or leading bids and tender responses for AI and technology engagements. 
  • Contribute to proposal writing, articulating our capabilities and differentiators, including authoring technical and architecture sections of bid responses to client tenders and RFPs. 
  • Support practice-level growth initiatives, including account planning, capability development, and go-to-market positioning for AI architecture and solutions engineering services.  

Technical architecture — what you will design 

You will be the design authority for enterprise AI platforms, able to reason across the full stack and make credible technology selections. We expect expert-level depth in several of the areas below and working knowledge across the rest. 

AI platform & cloud architecture 

  • Architect AI and Data Platforms using a mix of technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Claude Enterprise and the native services of Azure, AWS and GCP - selecting the right tool for the workload rather than defaulting to a single vendor. 
  • Design for scalability, security, cost efficiency and multi-cloud / hybrid patterns, with a strong grasp of containerisation, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven architectures and CI/CD. 
  • Balance technical excellence with delivery pragmatism and commercial realities, championing the path from prototype to production. 

Enterprise AI ecosystem integration 

  • Bring awareness of the broader enterprise landscape and how AI integrates with core operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and other systems of record and engagement. 
  • Design integration patterns that let AI capabilities interoperate safely with enterprise data, identity, workflow and process automation platforms – including MCP and A2A and how these capabilities enable an enterprise Agent mesh.  
  • Understand the data, governance and change implications of embedding AI into mission-critical enterprise processes. 

Orchestration & control plane 

  • Architect the orchestration and control-plane layer that governs how AI capabilities are exposed, routed and managed across the enterprise. 
  • Design MCP, AI and LLM gateway layers for secure, observable and policy-controlled access to models and tools. 
  • Design agent and skills registries — including recommending suitable technologies and patterns — to enable discovery, reuse and governance of agentic capabilities. 
  • Define the control plane for routing, rate limiting, cost management, model selection and version control across multiple model providers. 

AI solution design 

  • Design retrieval and reasoning architectures including RAG, corrective RAG (CRAG), and agentic patterns, selecting the right approach for a given business problem. 
  • Architect agent harnesses and their components — planning, memory, tool use, state management and multi-agent coordination. 
  • Design prompt strategies, context management and grounding approaches for reliable, production-grade LLM behaviour. 

Evaluation, guardrails & responsible AI 

  • Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails that make AI systems safe, reliable and measurable — covering accuracy, safety, bias, and task success. 
  • Embed responsible-AI and governance controls aligned to emerging regulation and client risk appetites. 
  • Define human-in-the-loop and fallback strategies for high-stakes use cases. 

Observability & operations 

  • Architect logging, monitoring, tracing and cost-observability across the AI stack, including model, agent and platform telemetry. 
  • Design for drift detection, performance monitoring and continuous evaluation in production (LLMOps / MLOps). 
  • Establish operational patterns for reliability, incident response and lifecycle management of AI systems at scale. 

 
Your skills and experience  

We're seeking a technically credible, commercially aware leader who brings a rare combination of architectural depth, delivery accountability and client advisory skill — someone energised by the complexity of taking AI solutions to production at scale. 

  • 7+ years in technology consulting, architecture or AI/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership or lead-architect role — including accountability for end-to-end solution design, resourcing and commercial outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to architect enterprise AI platforms across a mix of technologies (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP) with strong design capability across cloud, data and AI domains. 
  • Working understanding of how AI integrates with major operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow. 
  • Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, LLM gateways, MCP, RAG/CRAG, agent harnesses, evaluations and guardrails, and AI observability. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing and leading data & AI transformation programmes, and building high-performing teams in complex stakeholder environments — engaging comfortably at CTO, CDAO or engineering-director level. 
  • Track record of supporting or leading bid and proposal activity, including writing technical and architecture sections of responses to tenders and RFPs. 
  • A clear, confident communicator able to make the complex accessible for technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent depth through relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional ML Engineer, Databricks / Azure / GCP architecture credentials). 

Industry experience 

We would particularly like to hear from people who have designed and led data & AI transformation programmes across one or more of the following sectors: 

  • Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) 
  • Retail 
  • Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences 
  • Manufacturing 
  • Financial Services 
  • Government and Public Services  

Prior experience as an embedded or forward-deployed architect within a client environment, and exposure to regulated industries would be desired. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

 

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

 

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. title: Senior Risk Manager (Financial Risk)
description: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth. We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion. Role Overview The Senior Risk Manager (Financial Risk) will provide an independent second line of defence oversight, challenge and assurance over the Firm's financial risk profile, with a particular focus on liquidity risk, market risk and counterparty credit risk. You will play a key role in ensuring the ICARA process and Wind-Down Plan are robust, appropriately challenged and effectively embedded, working closely with Treasury, Trading and Finance first line teams. This role requires deep technical expertise in financial risk management, prudential regulation and capital/liquidity adequacy within an FCA-regulated investment firm. What you'll do Provide independent second line oversight, challenge and assurance over the Firm's liquidity risk, market risk and counterparty credit risk exposures, ensuring these remain within Board-approved risk appetite. Own and continuously enhance the 2LOD monitoring framework for liquidity risk, covering funding risk, market liquidity risk, intra-day liquidity risk, settlement risk, foreign currency position risk and liquidity concentration risk. Understand and challenge Group wide market risk exposures including interest rate risk, FX risk, trading risk, asset concentration risk and the Firm's exposure to extreme market events. Oversee and challenge the Firm's counterparty credit risk framework, including credit processing and aggregation risk, credit appetite and policy, and the identification of emerging credit risks and adverse counterparty trends. Provide second line input into the ICARA process, ensuring liquidity adequacy and capital adequacy risks are appropriately identified, quantified and stressed, and providing credible challenge to first line methodologies and assumptions. Ensure the Wind-Down Plan is fit for purpose, appropriately triggered via early warning indicators, and regularly tested, challenged and updated in line with regulatory expectations. Oversee and challenge liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, including severe but plausible and reverse stress test scenarios, to assess resilience under stressed conditions. Review and challenge the effectiveness of first line risk management performed by Treasury and intr-Group Trading entities/ functions, including the design of liquidity buffers, trading limits and counterparty credit limits. Support the identification and enhancement of quantitative and qualitative risk appetite measures for financial risk, ensuring appropriate tracking, escalation and remediation of breaches. Deliver periodic independent 2LOD assurance through thematic reviews and deep dives into Treasury operations and counterparty exposure management. Maintain oversight of relevant financial risk registers, ensuring risks are appropriately identified, assessed and tracked to resolution. Provide second line risk review and challenge for new products, trading venues, asset classes and strategic initiatives that could materially affect the Firm's liquidity, market or counterparty credit risk profile. Support ongoing monitoring of early warning indicators and contribute to Recovery and Resolution planning where relevant. Foster a healthy risk culture, promoting risk management as a universal responsibility and encouraging open, transparent discussion of financial risk issues without fear of retaliation. What you need to have Extensive experience in liquidity risk, market risk and/or counterparty credit risk management, ideally within an FCA-regulated investment firm, broker or trading platform. Strong working knowledge of the FCA's MIFIDPRU framework, including the ICARA process, liquidity adequacy assessment and Wind-Down Planning. Solid understanding of Treasury functions, including funding, liquidity buffer management and collateral management. Understanding of counterparty credit risk assessment methodologies, including exposure aggregation, credit appetite setting and counterparty due diligence. Proven second line of defence experience, with the ability to provide credible, evidence-based challenge to first line stakeholders including Treasury, Trading and Finance. Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience of stress testing and scenario analysis. Effective communication and report-writing skills, with experience presenting to senior management and Board-level committees. Experience with Recovery and Resolution Planning is highly desirable. Proficiency in risk management tools and software. What we offer Unique challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast Opportunity to make a big impact - you will create products used by millions of investors to build wealth Work with smart, high-performing colleagues with a common goal in a flat, cross-functional team structure An environment where nothing is set in stone, no bureaucracy Appreciation for your talent and ideas Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker! title: Enablement and Conversion Manager, Revenue Operations
description: Location: Remote in Europe About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. About the Role 🤔 Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us. Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for. Function one: enablement Training and standards Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there. Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how. Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar. Documentation and materials Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice. Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed. The channel to marketing Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer. The channel to product Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when. When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it. Function two: conversion Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there. Call scoring Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise. Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it. Send the reports out every week, to everyone. Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team. Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten. Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster. KYC Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip. Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed. Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written. Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team. How we will measure it 💻 Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort. KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average. Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly. 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role. What do we need from you? 💪 Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment. You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent. You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand. You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck. You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it. You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use. You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them. Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week. Nice to have ✨ Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business. Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace. A second language relevant to EMEA or North America. raw.title: Enablement and Conversion Manager, Revenue Operations
raw.description:
Location: Remote in Europe

 

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

 

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.

  • Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.

  • A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

 

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

 

Equal Opportunity

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l'IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Software Engineer, tu seras ammener à: 

  • Participer activement à la conception et à l'implémentation de solutions techniques robustes et scalables.
  • Architecture logicielle : Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'architecture de nos applications, en veillant à la performance et à la maintenabilité du code
  • Déploiement et opérations (DevOps) :  automatisation des tests et des déploiements cloud avec des pipelines CI/CD et une infrastructure en tant que code (ex : Terraform), packaging d'applications dans des conteneurs (ex : Docker), implémentation d'outils d'observabilité des données (ex : DBT)
  • Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure 
  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites
  • Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.
    • Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.
    • Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.
    • Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.
    • Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git.
  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Curiosité et proactivité : Tu as envie d'apprendre et de proposer de nouvelles idées.
    • Rigueur et souci du détail : Tu es soucieux(se) de produire un code propre et de qualité.
    • Esprit d'équipe : Tu es capable de travailler en collaboration et d'échanger avec des profils variés (Data Scientists, Consultants, etc.)
    • Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux 

Le processus de recrutement : pour rejoindre Artefact, nous te proposons un processus de recrutement en quatre étapes durant lequel tu auras l’occasion de parler de ton expérience et d'en apprendre davantage sur Artefact et le poste d'ingénieur logiciel.

  • Entretien RH
  • Entretien #1 – Test de codage avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #2 - Test d'architecture et de pipeline avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #3 - Entretien de motivation avec un Manager ou Directeur du pôle Data Engineering 

Processus d'onboarding : 

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Un counsellor te sera également attribué qui te guidera dans ta familiarisation avec la culture et les méthodes de travail de l'entreprise. De plus, tu auras l'opportunité de travailler sur des projets internes pour acquérir une expérience pratique et perfectionner tes compétences. De plus, tu auras la possibilité d'obtenir des certifications sur les fournisseurs cloud avant de travailler sur des missions clients. Ce processus d'intégration est conçu pour te doter des connaissances et des compétences nécessaires pour devenir un ingénieur logiciel performant chez Artefact.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris.
  • Un environnement de travail stimulant, où tu seras encouragé(e) à prendre des initiatives.
  • Un accompagnement par un mentor expérimenté pour te faire progresser rapidement.
  • L'opportunité de travailler sur des projets variés et complexes.

description: The AI Enablement Team is the catalyst for internal transformation and product acceleration across Actian. In the modern data landscape, AI is not a siloed experimental lab; it is a core capability that must be embedded into our product DNA and our engineering workflows. We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. You are not a theoretical researcher or a passive prompt engineer; you are a highly practical, technical driver who builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and frameworks that allow other product and engineering teams to deploy AI safely, rapidly, and at scale. You will democratize AI across the organization, establish modern LLMOps/MLOps practices, and directly impact the Actian Data Intelligence Platform by introducing agentic workflows, intelligent data pipelines, and cutting-edge capabilities. Core Responsibilities: Internal AI tooling: Design and maintain the core AI orchestration layers, centralized API gateways, and reusable frameworks (e.g., advanced RAG architectures, agentic frameworks) for company-wide consumption. Product AI Integration: Collaborate directly with core engineering teams to embed production-ready generative AI and machine learning features into the Actian Data Intelligence Platform. LLMOps & Governance Infrastructure: Establish strict guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring tools to track model performance, bias, data privacy, and security across all AI implementations. Cost & Latency Optimization: Actively monitor and manage cloud and API compute spend (token management, open-source vs. commercial models) and optimize execution latency for production AI features. Cross-Functional Upskilling: Lead workshops, design blueprints, and create documentation to empower non-AI engineering teams to build and maintain their own AI-driven features confidently. Rapid Prototyping (PoC to Production): Drive the engineering execution of high-impact AI proof-of-concepts, ensuring they are built with production-grade code that scales seamlessly. Standardization of Tooling: Define and enforce the organization's official AI stack, from vector database selection and vector embeddings strategies to semantic caching mechanisms. Vendor & Open-Source Strategy: Evaluate and manage partnerships with AI model providers and lead the technical assessment of cutting-edge open-source models to keep Actian at the vanguard of innovation. Data-Driven Impact Tracking: Define and track operational metrics for the AI Enablement function, such as developer adoption rates, reduction in time-to-market for AI features, and ROI of implemented AI tools. Qualifications & Profile: Technical Background: Strong background as a Senior AI/ML Engineer, LLMOps Engineer, or Software Architect who has successfully built and scaled AI-powered applications in enterprise SaaS or complex data platforms. AI & Engineering Mastery: Deep technical expertise in Python or Go, semantic search, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and fine-tuning or prompt engineering of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Extreme Ownership: High-agency mindset. You don’t wait for product teams to ask for AI capabilities; you proactively build the frameworks that solve their bottlenecks before they even identify them. Software Engineering Rigor: You treat AI development as software engineering. You understand CI/CD, unit testing for AI (evaluation datasets), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and clean code architecture. Influence Without Authority: Exceptional leadership and communication skills. You can inspire and align disparate engineering teams around a shared technical vision without being their direct line manager. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to demystify complex AI anomalies or architectures into clear business value for internal stakeholders and executives. What We Offer: The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space. Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid). Opportunities for professional growth and development. Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team. Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us. We value diversity at our company. raw.title: Front-end Engineer
raw.description:
Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments in the field. We are fully indexed on the success of every single user, which means the interfaces you ship support live defence operations.

You'd join the product development team as a front-end specialist, working closely with product design and engineering. You take an operational problem, explore it, come back with proposals, and iterate. Nobody hands you a fully specified ticket. Your job is to make complex information clear, fast, and dependable when the person using it cannot afford friction.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Own front-end delivery on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from interaction design through production

  • Build interfaces for real geospatial problems: interactive maps, multiple data layers, large datasets, and time-sensitive workflows well beyond a typical CRUD application

  • Work with product and design early, turning operational needs into clear flows and production-ready experiences

  • Raise the front-end quality bar across the team by reviewing and improving work from engineers with different specialities, including AI-assisted code

  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed and durability, especially when a high-stakes demo or deployment creates a short deadline

  • Help create reusable patterns that make the product more coherent as the team and surface area grow

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. We want someone who cares about front-end engineering as a craft and can still move quickly when the problem is ambiguous.

Must-have:

  • Strong production experience with React and TypeScript, with front-end engineering as a core part of your craft

  • A track record of owning complex interfaces from problem definition through release and iteration

  • Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out

  • Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate

  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities, while keeping the quality of what ships high

  • EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications

  • Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets

  • Experience building offline-capable or resource-constrained web applications

  • Experience creating or scaling a design system

  • Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology

What's In It For You

  • A top 0.1% European compensation package, including base salary and equity

  • Paris or London based

  • Ownership of a product surface used in real operational environments

  • Direct collaboration with product design and engineering, with room to shape front-end standards as the team grows

The Process

  1. Talent screening: 30 min, online. We cover your background, motivations, and what you want to own next.

  2. Front-end interview: 60 min, online. We assess React and TypeScript fundamentals, product judgement, and how you reason through an unfamiliar interface problem.

  3. Onsite in Paris: half day. You see the product, present a project you are proud of, and work through a front-end design and re-engineering exercise based on a realistic product problem.

  4. Roundtable: hiring committee reviews the full set of evidence and makes the final decision.
